title: Health worker density and distribution
graph_title: Ratio of health workers per 1,000 population
national_indicator_available: Ratio of health workers per 1,000 population
national_indicator_description: This indicator measures the number of skilled health workers per 1,000 population.
computation_definitions: The aggregate measure of health worker density includes medical doctors, nurses, and midwives. Separate measures are given for the number of medical doctors and nurses per 1,000 population, and for the number of midwives per 1,000 women between the ages of 15 and 49. Additionally, measures are given for the number of pharmacists and dentists per 1,000 population, but these are not included in the aggregate measure.
other_info: Some figures were calculated specifically for this indicator. In some cases, this has involved inversing figures provided for population per health worker. In other cases, it has involved dividing total figures for the number of health workers by the total relevant population. Population figures were sourced from census results and associated population projections.
comments_limitations: Since the methods used for obtaining these figures are not identical across data points, there may be some small variation caused by differing methods.
target_name: Substantially increase health financing and the recruitment, development, training and retention of the health workforce in developing countries, especially in least developed countries and small island developing States
indicator_definition: Density of physicians, nursing and midwifery personnel, dentistry personnel, and pharmaceutical personnel per 1,000 persons.
goal_meta_link_text: United Nations Sustainable Development Goals Metadata (PDF 207 KB)
source_other_info_1: This is the source for data from 2009-2014 and 2019-2024. Specifically, the data may be found in the [Rwanda Health Statistics Report 2009-2010](https://www.moh.gov.rw/fileadmin/user_upload/Moh/New_publication/Health_reports/Other_Reports/2009-10_Health_Statistical_Booklet.pdf), [Rwanda Annual Health Statistics Booklet 2013](https://www.moh.gov.rw/fileadmin/user_upload/Moh/New_publication/Health_reports/Booklets/Rwanda_Annual_Health_Statistics_Booklet_2013_signed.pdf) (which also includes data for 2011-2012), [Rwanda Annual Health Statistics Booklet 2014](https://www.moh.gov.rw/fileadmin/user_upload/Moh/New_publication/Health_reports/Booklets/Rwanda_Annual_Health_Statistics_Booklet_2014_.pdf), [Rwanda Health Sector Performance Report 2017-2019](https://www.moh.gov.rw/fileadmin/user_upload/Moh/New_publication/Health_reports/Annual_Reports/FINAL_Annual_Report_2017-2019_02062020.pdf), [Rwanda Health Sector Performance Report 2019-2020](https://www.moh.gov.rw/fileadmin/user_upload/Moh/New_publication/Health_reports/Annual_Reports/Health_sector_performance_Report_FY_2019-2020.pdf), [Health Sector Annual Performance Report 2020-2021](https://www.moh.gov.rw/fileadmin/user_upload/Moh/Publications/Reports/Health_Sector_Annual_Performance_Report_2020-2021.pdf), [Annual Health Sector Performance Report Fiscal Year 2021-2022](https://www.moh.gov.rw/fileadmin/user_upload/Moh/New_publication/Health_reports/Annual_Reports/FY2021-22_ANNUAL_PERFORMANCE_REPORT_-_27032023_APPROVED.pdf), [FY 2022/2023 Backward-Looking Joint Health Sector Review Meeting Report](https://moh.prod.risa.rw/fileadmin/user_upload/Moh/Publications/Reports/2022_23_BLJSR_24112023_Final_ABM_and_PS_Signed.pdf), and [Annual Health Statistical Booklet Fiscal Year 2023-2024](https://www.moh.gov.rw/fileadmin/user_upload/Moh/Publications/Reports/new_annual_Report/Annual_Statistical_Booklet_Fiscal_Year_2023-2024_Final_10102025.pdf). Data are provided in different formats across sources; some have been adapted to display in this dashboard. The original source for this data is the Human Resources for Health Information System (HRIS).
source_organisation_2: National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda (NISR)
source_other_info_2: This is the source for data from 2015. Data are provided as total numbers of health workers; these have been converted to ratios per 1,000 population by dividing by the relevant population figures and multiplying by 1,000. Population figures were sourced from the relevant [Population and Housing Census](https://statistics.gov.rw/data-sources/censuses/Population-and-Housing-Census) statistics and population projections. The original source for these figures is the Rwanda Health Management Information System (R-HMIS).
source_other_info_3: This is the source for data from 2016. Data are provided as ratios of population per health worker; these have been inversed to display in this dashboard. The original source for these figures is the Integrated Payroll and Personnel Information System (IPPIS) for the Rwanda public service, as well as surveys and the Annual Health Statistical Booklet.
